WriteTestDueDateTomorrow: Write test for Due date shows Tomorrow for todos due tomorrow
WriteTestDueDateOverdue: Write test for Due date shows Overdue for todos past their due date

WriteTestHeaderShowsSingularItem: Write test for Header shows correct count with singular item

WriteTestHeaderCountToggledActive: Write test for Header count updates when a todo is toggled back to active
WriteTestHeaderCountNewTodo: Write test for Header count updates when a new todo is added
WriteTestHeaderCountDeleted: Write test for Header count updates when a todo is deleted
WriteTestAddTodoPlaceholder: Write test for Add todo input displays placeholder text

WriteTestWhitespaceNoCreate: Write test for Pressing Enter with whitespace-only input does not create a todo
